vb_textbox.text: To get the mushroom in the game, you need to solve a five-pattern puzzle. There are two groups of gnomes: colored gnomes (pink, purple, brown) and regular gnomes (green, yellow/orange, blue). Each group must be dealt with one at a time, and you can switch between the groups as needed.First, work through the five-pattern sequence for one group. After completing the X5 pattern, the game resets to X1. You'll need to repeat this process with the other group to make progress. Remember to alternate between the groups to keep moving forward and eventually obtain the mushroom.
